_comment: FTF-R017 -- real S3 identity for the local SeaweedFS fixture. Format verified against SeaweedFS's own docker/compose/s3.json example (github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs, Apache-2.0). Deliberately carries NO 'anonymous' identity: an unsigned/unauthenticated request must be rejected, proving this endpoint enforces caller identity (Section 65.2) rather than SeaweedFS's own unconfigured default of accepting any access key. Development-only credentials, not a production secret -- matches the same local-dev-only convention as this compose file's postgres password.
